title: Your Bank Might Charge You $35 For a $4 Coffee

lines: Your bank might charge you thirty five dollars for a four dollar coffee.
scenes.img: a shocked young woman with a ponytail in a coffee shop holding a small coffee cup and staring at her phone, vertical composition

lines: If your account is a little short, many banks still approve the payment.
scenes.img: a debit card being tapped on a card reader at a coffee shop counter, green approved light, vertical composition

lines: Then they hit you with an overdraft fee. Often around thirty five dollars.
scenes.img: a big old-fashioned bank building with a grumpy fat cat banker counting money on the steps, cartoon, vertical composition

lines: Three small purchases on a bad day? That can be over a hundred dollars in fees.
scenes.img: a young woman with a ponytail at home at night staring at her laptop with three red warning notifications, stressed, vertical composition

lines: Here's the fix. Open your bank app and turn off overdraft coverage for debit card purchases.
scenes.img: {HERO} sitting on a couch confidently tapping a toggle switch in a bank app on his phone, vertical composition

lines: If you're short, the card just gets declined. Awkward for a second, but free.
scenes.img: {HERO} at a store checkout shrugging and smiling after a card decline, the cashier smiling back kindly, vertical composition

lines: Then set a low balance alert, so your phone warns you first.
scenes.img: a smartphone on a table with a bell notification icon glowing, {HERO}'s hand reaching for it, vertical composition

lines: Two minutes today can save you hundreds. Follow for one simple money move every day!
scenes.img: {HERO} giving a thumbs up and smiling in a cozy room, vertical composition
